content.short: Hop Protocol Subgraph facilitates optimal querying of on-chain Hop protocol data.
content.description: Hop Protocol Subgraph indexes Hop Protocol on-chain activity and provides a queryable view of cross-chain asset bridging. It enables developers to access and analyze data related to bridging assets across Ethereum-based networks, including Ethereum, Optimism, Arbitrum, xDAI, and Polygon. By indexing relevant Hop contracts and events, the subgraph supports flexible queries on bridged assets, transfers, and liquidity movements, empowering analytics, dashboards, and tooling for anyone building with Hop’s cross-chain infrastructure.
